featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Lad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic and unacceptable experience with The Sleep Company – Hughes Road, Mumbai.

I placed an order for a Tranquo Massage Chair worth ₹23,000 on 24th March, specifically as a birthday gift for my father on 27th March. The store didn’t even have the chair on display I still went ahead purely based on the assurance of their salesperson Rushi and the brand name. That turned out to be a BIG mistake.

Despite clearly informing them about the urgency, I was assured delivery before 27th March. On 27th — no delivery. Instead, I’m told it’s “out of stock” and pushed to 29th March.

On 28th March, I receive a message saying the order is READY for delivery on 29th and I even select a time slot. 29th March comes — no delivery, no update, nothing.

After chasing them again on 30th March, I’m told the same story by another staff member Asif — “out of stock” and now delayed to 2nd April. How is a product “ready” one day and “out of stock” the next? This is blatant misinformation and complete mismanagement.

Both Rushi and Asif have done nothing except offer hollow apologies with zero accountability or resolution. Rushi is almost always unavailable — sometimes he’s “out for lunch”, later the same day someone else says he hasn’t come to the store at all, or that he’s out, on leave, or unavailable for some reason or the other. This clearly shows the level of professionalism here.

I even received calls from The Sleep Company team regarding this issue but all they did was repeat the same apologetic script. On 27th, they apologized and assured delivery on 29th. On 30th, the same script again with a new date of 2nd April. This is nothing but blatant misinformation and false assurances.

In this entire process, I am the one constantly calling and following up for updates. Even after multiple calls, only then I am informed that the order is delayed. They don’t even have the basic courtesy to proactively inform the customer about delays.

Because of this irresponsible and unprofessional behavior, a birthday gift planned in advance was completely ruined. The mental frustration and inconvenience caused is something your repeated apologies don’t fix.

For a company that markets itself as premium, this is shockingly poor service misleading commitments, no stock clarity, zero coordination, and no accountability.

Avoid this store or even the company itself if you value your time, money, and peace of mind.

You’re honestly better off going to a local chair shop; they’ll do the job far better than these so-called “premium” players.

featured_reviews.name: Arihan Jalan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I vetted 14 different local vendors and more online for a project involving metal cutting/ fabrication and powder coating. I chose Dinesh/ DK PVD Coating for three main reasons:

1) Technical specificity: Dinesh was the only vendor who sat down to truly understand my requirements vs. handwaving it away by saying "banaa dengee". He actually spent 15-20 minutes understanding my scope of work/ specs.

2) Honest consultancy: Dinesh is intellectual, well-spoken, and proactive. He actually recommended against more expensive SS 316 and cheaper mild steel, helping me settle on SS 304 for my specific use case rather than trying to upsell me

3) Fair Pricing: Dinesh's pricing is at parity with the rest of the market; i.e.- he charges fair rates.

And post-delivery, here's why I'm going back to him for future projects-

4) Communication: Dinesh is very responsive regardless of day or time. If there are delays, he both explains why and commits to an updated timeline. In a world where you have to wait 3-4 days for contractors to get back to you, his comms style is welcome. (Note- my parts took ~10 days to make; the actual work happens in a factory some distance away)

5) Post-sales support: I commissioned 10 pieces; two precision parts were slightly off. Without any fuss or argument, Dinesh offered a rush re-make with a 3-day turnaround. Seeing a fabricator stand behind their work- and just fixing it vs. trying to "jugaad" a solution is a rare sight; and I respect his attitude towards making it right.

6) Sourcing integrity: When Dinesh realized he didn't have the specific non-standard stainless steel tubes I requested, he called to clarify the load nature of the part and went out to find + source the correct material rather than quietly swapping it for mild steel

All parts arrived with smoothened edges and an immaculate powder-coated finish. I used 2mm SS 304, though he also works with mild steel and aluminum. If you need powder coating, laser cutting, or precision bending, I recommend going with Dinesh. I'll definitely be both working with him again as well as recommending him within my circles.
